findings.location: source.html, aya ya huduma ya kupunguza maumivu, sentensi ya kwanza
findings.source_quote: This is a type of care that is specifically designed to treat the pain and other symptoms, usually of a terminally ill patient (to keep them comfortable, not to try to cure them). This is the sort of care that is offered by hospice programs.
findings.suggested_fix: Tofautisha huduma ya kupunguza maumivu na huduma za hospice: “Hii ni aina ya huduma iliyoundwa mahsusi kutibu maumivu na dalili nyingine, kwa kawaida kwa mgonjwa aliye mahututi (ili kumstarehesha, wala si kujaribu kumponya). Aina hii ya huduma hutolewa na programu za hospice.”
findings.translation_quote: Hii ni aina ya huduma iliyoundwa mahsusi kutibu maumivu na dalili nyingine, kwa kawaida kwa mgonjwa aliye mahututi (ili kumstarehesha, wala si kujaribu kumponya). Hii ndiyo aina ya huduma inayotolewa na programu za huduma ya wagonjwa mahututi.
